description: This file contains declarations of helper routines used in the Android USB API, specifically related to ADB (Android Debug Bridge). It defines functions for converting access types, enumerating device interfaces, retrieving device details and names, and checking interface compatibility with custom USB drivers.

methods.name: GetSDKComplientParam
methods.description: Converts access type and share mode from custom enumerations to SDK-compliant values.

methods.name: EnumerateDeviceInterfaces
methods.description: Enumerates interfaces for a given hardware device info handle and class ID.

methods.name: GetUsbDeviceDetails
methods.description: Retrieves detailed data about a specific USB device interface.

methods.name: GetUsbDeviceName
methods.description: Gets the name of a USB device given device info data.

methods.name: IsLegacyInterface
methods.description: Checks if a given interface is available via a custom USB driver, indicating it is not available via WinUsb.
